description: The bar chart illustrates the number of participants (N=6) who identified each evaluation criterion as beneficial for a generative-AI-driven claim retrieval system. The horizontal axis represents the "Number of Participants," ranging from 0 to 6, while the vertical axis lists the evaluation criteria. The criteria are "Relevant FCs," "FC Summary," "Relevance Explanation," "Clarity and Simplicity," "Overall Summary," "Filters," and "Veracity Explanation." The bars, colored in shades of purple, blue, teal, green, and yellow, show the count of participants for each criterion. "Relevant FCs" was the most frequently highlighted criterion, with 6 participants selecting it. "FC Summary" was selected by 5 participants. "Relevance Explanation" and "Clarity and Simplicity" were each selected by 3 participants. "Overall Summary" was selected by 2 participants. "Filters" and "Veracity Explanation" were each selected by 1 participant. The bars are sorted in descending order of participant count, with the longest bar at the top.
